rows: Parthia Health — Heart Failure Clinical Knowledge Base
Organizes the clinical knowledge the safety engine and AI agents use. Every rule and card must trace back to a registered source.
One row per source document (guideline, decision pathway, statement, drug label, patient education). Record version, license status and whether full text may be stored.
Deterministic logic for the safety engine: thresholds and yes/no checks. The software engineer turns each approved row into code and a test.
One guideline recommendation per row, written in your own words, with metadata. Loaded into the knowledge base for agents to retrieve and cite.
Progress for the 10 clinical domains: targets (blue, editable) and approved counts (automatic).
Reference ranges, heart failure targets, alert and urgent limits for each measurement, with the order agents use to pick a threshold.
What to enter in each column, how agents must use the dictionary, and which sources complete it.
The patient data we capture and why. Each element lists the rules that need it, its standard code, source and frequency.
Clinical scenarios with the expected findings, including negative tests. Engineers run these after every change.
Allowed values for the dropdown columns. Edit here to add options.
Add each new source to the Source register first and give it an ID (S01, S02…).
Extract rules and cards from that source; put its Source ID in every row.
Write recommendations in your own words (copyright). Note the section/page so anyone can verify.
Set Review status. Only rows marked 'Approved' are used by the app.
A second clinician reviews every row before approval; fill in Reviewed by and Date reviewed.
Pre-filled DRAFT examples. Thresholds, classes of recommendation and levels of evidence must be verified against the original source before approval.
Category, Severity, Agent, Review status, License status and similar columns use lists from the Lists sheet.
